publicCacheInputs.mechanism: Reuse inspected helper: symlink public read caches into owned Cargo home, with cache cleanup disabled. Cargo lock/global cache metadata belongs in owned Cargo home. Pin/recheck public registry source bytes and archives before/after; do not infer fully immutable shared cache behavior without observed comparison.
publicCacheInputs.resolutionCaveat: Workspace frozen resolution can inspect existing cached SDK Git package metadata even though no native dependency is compiled. Missing cache refuses offline; never fetch, install dependencies, retry or enable native.

sourceExport: Write only checked-in files from WORKSPACE-EXPORT-PINS into owned source; no Git/project admin metadata exported. Hash every exported file.
configurationPrecondition: No .cargo/config or config.toml at owned source member/ancestors, cwd/ancestors or owned Cargo home. Environment is replaced, so no inherited RUST*_WRAPPER, RUSTFLAGS, LD_PRELOAD or provider/import settings.
cleanup: Finally remove only owned root, never traverse linked public cache roots; preserve complete external per-step logs/receipts and installed executable hash before deletion. Verify owned process session empty on every terminal return.
effectClassification: Ordinary full frontend compile/install plus pure local Core1 evaluator; not SDK VM/native contract execution. Normal Rust build.rs/proc-macros and linker effects are part of this preparation, not hook-free claims.
independence: Existing pre-consumer independent financial freezes retained byte-identically; exact generated file/CLI wire expectations separately author-composed before this consumer.
unobserved: Selected Cargo unit graph and elapsed feasibility remain unobserved.
GP has a local unapproved 2-path stage report candidate; this preparation is not its source/result approval.
